name: tilt-card
title: Tilt Card
description: A card that tilts toward the pointer in 3D on a spring, with an optional soft glare that follows the cursor.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest tilt in degrees, reached at the card's edge.

props.name: glare
props.description: Adds a soft highlight that follows the pointer.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the tilt off. The card is also flat on touch devices and under reduced motion.
